cleaning_prompt:
DATASET: U.S. monthly VMT panel. Clean the CURRENT row month only.

ROLE: national VMT-driver filter — DATE HARD yes, over-delete no.
Prior run emptied ~33% of months; avoid that. Keep broader on-year U.S. signals.

FORBIDDEN: year cutoffs; stuffing; inventing; wiping rows that still have on-year
U.S. drivers; keeping facts whose printed year is ≥2 years from THIS row year.

KEEP (on-year U.S.): fuel/gasoline/diesel; holiday/leisure travel; weather/roads;
freight; capacity; remote-work/congestion/fuel-tax policy; VMT prints with drivers;
also regional multi-state shocks and state-DOT volume/fuel notes if dated on-year.
Weak but on-year U.S. facts → KEEP (do not require "national only").

DROP: ads; foreign tourism; software marketing; pure off-year recycled dumps.
Single-city AADT: drop only if no broader driver; else keep briefly.

DATE HARD: ±1 year; mixed → keep on-year only. Empty ONLY if nothing on-year remains.
